# Ebenezer Ojeba

> Ebenezer Ojeba is a full-stack software developer based in Lagos, Nigeria, and the founder of OJ Tech Solution. He builds scalable web applications, AI-powered platforms, SaaS products, business management systems, e-commerce platforms and custom software, working mainly with React, Next.js, Node.js, Express and MongoDB.

- Name: Ebenezer Ojeba
- Title: Full-Stack Software Developer
- Business: OJ Tech Solution (the business name Ebenezer Ojeba works under; he is its founder)
- Location: Lagos, Nigeria. Works with clients in Nigeria and remotely worldwide.
- Website: https://ebenezerojeba.vercel.app/

## Quick facts

### Who is Ebenezer Ojeba?

Ebenezer Ojeba is a full-stack software developer based in Lagos, Nigeria, and the founder of OJ Tech Solution. He builds web applications, SaaS products, AI-powered platforms, e-commerce sites and business management systems for startups, businesses and organisations.

### What has Ebenezer Ojeba built?

His projects include GetConfident, an AI impromptu speaking coach; Homebase, a rental platform for Lagos landlords and tenants; SkillLink, an artisan booking marketplace; PalmsBeauty, a salon booking system; the APC Lagos Digital Management System and APC Lagos information platform; and the official website of Hon. Cornelius Ojelabi.

### What technologies does Ebenezer Ojeba work with?

He works mainly with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS on the frontend, Node.js, Express.js and REST APIs on the backend, and MongoDB for data. He integrates payments with Paystack and AI features with the OpenAI API, and deploys to Vercel and Render.

### What is OJ Tech Solution?

OJ Tech Solution is the software development business of Ebenezer Ojeba, based in Lagos, Nigeria. It offers full-stack web development, custom web applications, SaaS development, AI-powered applications, e-commerce development, business management systems, API and backend development, and website development and redesign.

### Does Ebenezer Ojeba work with clients outside Nigeria?

Yes. He is based in Lagos and works remotely with clients in Nigeria and other countries.

### How can I hire Ebenezer Ojeba?

Send a project enquiry through the contact page at ebenezerojeba.vercel.app/contact, or message him on WhatsApp. You can also connect with him on LinkedIn or see his code on GitHub (github.com/ebenezerojeba).

## Services

- [Full-Stack Web Development](https://ebenezerojeba.vercel.app/services/full-stack-web-development/): Production web apps with accounts, dashboards, APIs, payments and an admin area, built end to end.
- [Custom Web Application Development](https://ebenezerojeba.vercel.app/services/custom-web-applications/): Websites, portals, platforms and internal tools designed around how your organisation actually works.
- [SaaS Platform Development](https://ebenezerojeba.vercel.app/services/saas-development/): Multi-user software products with onboarding, user dashboards, notifications and per-account data security.
- [AI-Powered Application Development](https://ebenezerojeba.vercel.app/services/ai-application-development/): Products that use large language models for analysis, feedback and automation, with output you can trust.
- [E-commerce Website & Platform Development](https://ebenezerojeba.vercel.app/services/ecommerce-development/): Online stores with catalogues, carts, Paystack checkout and an admin panel for products and orders.
- [Business Management System Development](https://ebenezerojeba.vercel.app/services/business-management-systems/): Registration, booking, approval and record-keeping systems with role-based dashboards and reports.
- [API & Backend Development](https://ebenezerojeba.vercel.app/services/api-backend-development/): Secure REST APIs and Node.js backends for web and mobile apps: auth, validation, payments and webhooks.
- [Website Development & Redesign](https://ebenezerojeba.vercel.app/services/website-development-redesign/): Fast, accessible, mobile-first websites, and redesigns of sites that have become slow or dated.

## Case studies

- [GetConfident](https://ebenezerojeba.vercel.app/projects/getconfident/): An AI impromptu speaking coach that gives instant feedback on clarity, structure, confidence, pace and filler words. Stack: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Prisma, OpenAI API, Zod, Vitest, Playwright.
- [Homebase](https://ebenezerojeba.vercel.app/projects/homebase/): A mobile-first rental platform for Lagos: rent directly from landlords, with a shared tenancy record for landlords and tenants. Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MongoDB, Mongoose, Zod, Paystack, Cloudinary, Server-Sent Events, Vitest, Playwright.
- [APC Lagos Digital Management System](https://ebenezerojeba.vercel.app/projects/apc-lagos-digital-management-system/): Registration and management of polling unit agents and collation officers across Lagos State, with document upload, approvals and reports. Stack: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router, React Hook Form, Zod, Recharts, Express 5, MongoDB, Mongoose, JWT (HTTP-only cookies), Helmet, Nodemailer.
- [APC Lagos Information Platform](https://ebenezerojeba.vercel.app/projects/apc-lagos/): The digital information platform for the All Progressives Congress, Lagos State Chapter: leadership, 57 councils, representatives, candidates and news. Stack: Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Zod.
- [SkillLink](https://ebenezerojeba.vercel.app/projects/skillink/): A marketplace that connects clients with skilled artisans, with bookings, real-time chat and reviews. Stack: MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js, Socket.io, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.
- [Hon. Cornelius Ojelabi Official Website](https://ebenezerojeba.vercel.app/projects/hon-cornelius-ojelabi-website/): The official website of the APC Lagos State Chairman, with a separate admin dashboard for managing content. Stack: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, React Router, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT, Helmet.
- [PalmsBeauty](https://ebenezerojeba.vercel.app/projects/palmsbeauty/): An appointment booking platform for a beauty salon in St. John's, Newfoundland, with an admin panel for managing bookings. Stack: MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.

## Other projects

- Paragon Hub (https://paragonhub.vercel.app): MERN e-commerce site with a separate admin panel for inventory and order management, real-time product update notifications and secure payment integration.
- Palatial (https://palatial.onrender.com): Full-stack food delivery and event planning platform with Paystack payments, delivery options, Calendly meeting scheduling, an admin dashboard for events and orders, notifications and map integration.
- AdminElectrack (https://adminelectrack.vercel.app): React and Vite admin dashboard with interactive charts, user and role management and a responsive layout.
- Benchat (https://benchat.vercel.app): Chat application with Firebase authentication, real-time messaging and user status updates.
- CoinTracker (https://cointracker-smoky.vercel.app): React site showing up-to-date cryptocurrency prices and market trends from a public API.
